actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

official_title: A bill to regulate monitoring of electronic communications between an incarcerated person in a Bureau of Prisons facility and that person's attorney or other legal representative, and for other purposes.
short_title: Effective Assistance of Counsel in the Digital Era Act

summary.text:
Effective Assistance of Counsel in the Digital Era Act

This bill requires the Department of Justice to issue a report regarding, establish guidelines for, and create or modify a program or system through which an incarcerated person may send or receive an electronic communication that excludes from monitoring the contents of any privileged electronic communication between the incarcerated person and his or her legal representative. Attorney-client privilege shall apply to electronic communications sent or received through this program or system.
